input.title: Women's Crochet – No, I Won't Make You One. Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This crochet zip up hoodie is for the crocheter who has heard "can you make me one?" one too many times, zipped on for the craft night and the yarn shop.

A granny-square crochet sweater with a paper tag lies beside a ball of cream yarn and a crochet hook, in mustard, sage, coral and cream with a worn print texture. NO, I WON'T runs above it in two lines and MAKE YOU ONE. below in heavy high-contrast serif capitals, the last line wider than the first: coral and cream on Black and Navy, brick red and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small NO. in the same heavy serif capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word WON'T is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest NO. wordmark and left-cuff WON'T, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the No, I Won't Make You One. zip hoodie fit?
The No, I Won't Make You One. crochet zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this crochet hoodie warm enough for cozy craft nights?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cozy craft nights, drafty yarn shops and the walk home with a new skein well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, NO, I WON'T above the sweater and MAKE YOU ONE. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small NO. in the same heavy serif capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and WON'T is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The NO. wordmark on the chest and the WON'T cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a crocheter, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend whose hook never stops and whose answer is still no. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
